በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ወነገረ: ነገር — and the affairs of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word, matter of'; the spelling is also that of a verb 'and he said') (?)
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ታቦትሰ: ታቦት — ark (noun) + enclitic -ሰ marking contrast, 'as for the Ark'
አድኀኖ: አድኀነ — he saved him (3ms perfect, causative a-stem of ድኅነ + -ሁ '3ms him')
ወተናገሮ: ተናገረ — and he spoke with him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem, n-g-r; + -ኦ 'him')
ለአብርሃም: አብርሃም — to Abraham (ለ- + proper name) · object-marking ለ- doubling the suffix of አፍለሶ (አፍለሶ እግዚኣብሔር ለአብርሃም 'God moved Abraham') · ለ- marking the owner (እኁሁ ለአብርሃም 'his brother, Abraham's')
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
ዘኢይነቅዝ: ነቀዘ — which does not rot (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, n-q-z 'be worm-eaten, decay')
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
በዕፀ: ዕፅ — by the wood of (በ- + noun, construct state)
ሳቤቅ: ሳቤቅ — Sabek (proper name, qualifying ዕፀ 'tree of'; uncertain) (?)
አብትረ: በትር — rods (plural አብትር, accusative after the number 'twelve')
ወደየ: ወደየ — he put, placed (3ms perfect, G, w-d-y); ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
በትሩ: በትር — his rod (በትር + -ሁ '3ms his', the suffix showing as -u on the final ር)
ተባረከ: ባረከ — he was blessed (3ms perfect, passive-reflexive ተ- stem of ባረከ, b-r-k)
ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
ይነሥኣ: ነሥአ — he takes her (3ms imperfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
እምሀገረ: ሀገር — from the city of (እም- + noun, construct)
ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of') · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (ወንሥኣ ለታቦተ ሕጉ 'and take the Ark of his law')
ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
በቅድሜሃ: ቅድሜ — before her (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- 'front' + -ሃ '3fs her')
ረሰያ: ረሰየ — he made her (3ms perfect, G, r-s-y + -ሃ '3fs her')
ለታቦት: ታቦት — of the ark (ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix + noun)
መድኀኒተ: መድኀኒት — salvation, saviour (noun; accusative predicate: 'you will be a salvation', i.e. a saviour) · construct 'salvation of' (መድኀኒተ ደቂቅከ 'the salvation of your sons') · 'of the saviour' before a relative clause (መድኀኒተ ዘተፈነወ 'of the saviour who was sent')
እምትካት: ትካት — from the foundation, from of old (?) (እም- 'from' + ትካት 'establishment', cf. ዘትካት in ch. 30; sense uncertain) (?)
በአርአያ: አርአያ — after the pattern of, in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct)
ወጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — and exactly, accurately (ወ- + adjective, adverbial accusative)
እከሥት: ከሠተ — I will reveal, explain (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G)
ለክሙ: ለ — to you, for you (preposition ለ- with 2mp suffix -ክሙ)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
እምቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — from the first, from the beginning (እም- + adj. as noun)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
በዕፅ: ዕፅ — with wood (በ- + ዕፅ 'wood, tree', noun)
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?)
ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (ስሕተቱ ለአዳም 'Adam's error') and in apposition (ላዕሌሁ ለአዳም 'upon him, upon Adam')
ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began') · noun 'the first, the beginning' (በእንተ ቀዳሚ 'concerning the Beginning'; ቀዳሚ ትርጓሜሁ ክርስቶስ 'the beginning, its interpretation is Christ')
ረሰየ: ረሰየ — set, appoint, make (3ms perfect, G, r-s-y)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ፈጣሪ: ፈጣሪ — creator, maker (noun; participle of ፈጠረ)
ወሃቤ: ወሃቢ — giver of (agent noun of ወሀበ 'give', construct ወሃቤ; the initial ወ is a root letter, not 'and', as in ወወሃቤ ch. 24; ወሃቤ ሲሳይ 'giver of food')
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
ፈጠረ: ፈጠረ — he created (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ኀጢአት: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, fem.; here genitive after construct ርስሐተ 'defilement of sin') · after ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ኀጢአት 'without sin') · predicate, 'are sin' (ምግባሮሙ ኀጢአት)
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city') · accusative of place 'in the city' (ይነብር ሀገረ 'he would stay in the city')
ምስካይ: ምስካይ — refuge, shelter (?) (noun; uncertain lexical call (?))
ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
ያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — he loves (3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ለንጹሓን: ንጹሕ — of the pure ones (ለ- naming the owner after a suffix + plural ንጹሓን)
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (አዝማዲሆሙ ለእለ ኀልቁ 'the kinsmen of those who perished')
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him') · 'with him, in his hand' expressing possession or disposal (እስመ ኀቤሁ ክብር ወኀሳር 'for with him are glory and loss')
ወያድኅኖሙ: አድኀነ — and he saves them (ወ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሙ 'them')
ወይገብር: ገብረ — and he does, makes (ወ- + 3m sg imperfect, g-b-r)
አምሳለ: አምሳል — likeness, image (construct 'likeness of') · accusative 'likenesses, types' after ብዙኀ 'many' (ብዙኀ አምሳለ 'many likenesses')
ለቅድስት: ቅዱስ — for the holy (ለ- + adjective, fem. sg. ቅድስት)
ወቦእለ: ቦ — and there are those who (ወ- + ቦ 'there is' + relative እለ, run together)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ንስግድ: ሰገደ — we worship, let us worship (1cp subjunctive/imperfect, s-g-d)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will') · as object after ሰብሐ ('praise God', ይሴብሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ወላዲተ: ወላዲት — bearer of, mother of (noun, fem., construct; active participle of ወለደ; ወላዲተ አምላክ 'Mother of God')
ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate)
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
በስመ: ስም — by the name of (በ- 'by, in' + construct 'name of')
ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
ወአውሥኦሙ: አውሥአ — and he answered them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative-type stem + -ሙ '3mp them')
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
መጽአ: መጽአ — he/it came (3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
መፍቀሬ: መፍቀሪ — lover of (noun, construct, from ፈቀረ 'love')
ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
ወሰፍሐ: ሰፍሐ — and he spread out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-f-ḥ)
እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
